validatedTree: baseCommit plus the changes identified by sourceFileSha256 (documentation excluded)
scope: CORE-HARDENING structure foundation item 2, third step: writes commit only after a decision made inside their transaction, after their locks

policy::Write opens the transaction; Write::decide / decide_all (app actions) and Write::decide_platform (Administer, RequestApp) read the facts through it and return Decided, the only type that commits. Dropping either rolls back

The decision share-locks the actor's user row and delegation row until commit, so disabling the user, revoking administrator rights or revoking the delegation waits for an in-flight write. Grant and group rows are not locked

Converted: all administrator writes (domain::admin_locked removed), installation approval changes, app registration requests, runtime and database admission, test acceptance, release and installation creation, image upload, log request, dev-session creation and heartbeat, build admission, app-call tokens and delegation issue (new AppAction::Delegate)

scripts/check-write-decisions.py (in check-static.sh rust) fails on a raw transaction or a principal handler's write outside policy::Write unless the function is listed with a reason (identity flows, own credential or lease reductions, read-only snapshots, worker bookkeeping); listed entries that no longer apply also fail
behaviorChanges: POST /api/v1/installations, POST /api/v1/database/prepare and POST /api/v1/delegations decide again after their lock waits: a developer whose grant is revoked during the wait gets 403 and nothing is written (previously installation creation and delegation issue answered 200, and database preparation answered 403 but kept the stored job)
Database preparation stores the job and decides in one transaction and answers with the job read there (previously the receipt was read with a separate use check after the insert)

Release creation, dev-session heartbeat, app-call token issue, image upload, log request, dev-session and build admission now also decide inside their transaction before commit; their admission checks are unchanged
User disable, administrator revocation and delegation revocation wait for writes already decided under them
